reviews.title: Doesn’t come with adaptor
reviews.comment: The listing says it comes with a power adaptor. But mine didn’t have it. Don’t waste your time and buy the adaptor when you buy this.
reviews.author: R

reviews.title: Brings Expedition 33 to Life
reviews.comment: What an amazing card (4070 Super 12gb) ! I gambled by buying a used card and it was a great bet. My games like Final Fantasy Rebirth, God of War, Expedition 33, and more have been amazing on my 1440p gaming monitor. I knocked off 1 star because this is the only card where I get a "Out of Range" error if I just let it sit on the desktop for like 10 min which forces me to have to restart the computer. This only happened after getting this card, but otherwise it's amazing! And this is coming from a 4060ti 8gb graphic card.
